      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">

      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">

    </decisionTable>

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Fixed Preference Trigger
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: High Rate Sensitivity Trigger
testSuite.description: Applicant has high sensitivity to rate changes.

testSuite.name: Rule 1: Both Rule 1 Conditions
testSuite.description: Applicant has both fixed preference and high sensitivity.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Typical Case
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all criteria for ARM 7/1.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Boundary Case
testSuite.description: Boundary values: 7 years, 80% LTV, 720 score.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Fails - Horizon Too Long
testSuite.description: Horizon is 8 years, which is > 7.

testSuite.name: Rule 2: ARM 7/1 Fails - Income Unstable
testSuite.description: Income stability is variable.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - Low Credit Score
testSuite.description: Credit score is below 640.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High DTI
testSuite.description: DTI is above 50.

testSuite.name: Rule 3: Manual Review - High LTV
testSuite.description: LTV is above 95.

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 1 vs Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) takes precedence over Rule 3 (ManualReview) because it is listed first.

testSuite.name: Precedence: Rule 2 vs Rule 3
testSuite.description: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) takes precedence over Rule 3 (ManualReview) because it is listed first.

testSuite.name: No Rule Applies: Default Case
testSuite.description: No rules are met.

testSuite.name: Boundary: Rule 3 - Credit Score 640
testSuite.description: Credit score 640 is not < 640, so Rule 3 does not trigger.

testSuite.name: Boundary: Rule 3 - DTI 50
testSuite.description: DTI 50 is not > 50, so Rule 3 does not trigger.

testSuite.name: Boundary: Rule 3 - LTV 95
testSuite.description: LTV 95 is not > 95, so Rule 3 does not trigger.

testSuite.name: Fixed30_ExplicitPreference
testSuite.description: Applicant explicitly prefers a fixed rate.

testSuite.name: Fixed30_HighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Applicant has high rate sensitivity.

testSuite.name: ARM7/1_BoundaryCondition
testSuite.description: Applicant meets all ARM 7/1 criteria at the exact boundaries.

testSuite.name: ARM7/1_TypicalScenario
testSuite.description: Applicant meets ARM 7/1 criteria with typical values.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_LowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Applicant has a credit score below 640.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_HighDTI
testSuite.description: Applicant has a DTI ratio above 50.

testSuite.name: ManualReview_HighLTV
testSuite.description: Applicant has an LTV ratio above 95.

testSuite.name: Precedence_Rule1_Over_Rule3
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) takes precedence over Rule 3 (ManualReview) when both conditions are met.

testSuite.name: Precedence_Rule1_Over_Rule2
testSuite.description: Rule 1 (Fixed30) takes precedence over Rule 2 (ARM7/1) when both conditions are met.

testSuite.name: NoRule_TypicalNonMatch
testSuite.description: No rules apply to the applicant.

testSuite.name: Rule2_Fail_Horizon
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails because horizonYears is greater than 7.

testSuite.name: Rule2_Fail_Stability
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails because incomeStability is not 'stable'.

testSuite.name: Rule2_Fail_LTV
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails because LTV is greater than 80.

testSuite.name: Rule2_Fail_CreditScore
testSuite.description: Rule 2 fails because creditScore is less than 720.

testSuite.name: Rule3_Boundary_NonTrigger
testSuite.description: Applicant values are exactly on the thresholds that do not trigger ManualReview.
